method: Raw binary STL exact-coordinate weld only; actual mesh intersection crops, unrounded horizontal sections, even-odd nesting, exact -0.4 mm Shapely erosion on each positive connected component. No healing, removal of islands, or thin-feature exemption.

tests.feature: open sagging hanging net, roof excluded
tests.note: Crop is the real trapezoid aperture inset 1 mm, extruded from z20 to45. Thus surrounding roof/terrace mass cannot hide rope thinness. End-of-crop near-tangent sections are retained; the inset intentionally excludes the perimeter anchoring cable.
Only exposed rim above the slab is sampled. This does not represent total roof thickness; the crop includes its entire ~1.2 mm horizontal depth.
Full front-floor edge plus timber overlay; underside overhang is separately counted. Horizontal erosion is not vertical slab-thickness measurement.
Free end, away from simplified central pedestal. Gray slab plus thin timber overlay are retained.
Free counter end away from its pedestal; 1.8 mm nominal vertical slab is not a validated bridge span.

tests.feature: central long roof slot remains open
tests.note: Conservative internal corridor of the entire long slot above the ground stairs; does not cross the real edge posts. Entire volume must be zero.
Tree omitted in display model, but full internal aperture remains empty. Inset excludes real rim; all volume above ground is tested.
Local person-passage corridor above the low floor and below the roof, avoiding the known load-column axes; not a full accessibility assessment.
Air below ropes inside the open net aperture; would detect a filled backing slab.

tests.feature: hanging net cell is genuinely open
tests.note: Small vertical probe inside a wide cell. This certifies one actual open cell, not every knot or aperture.

tests.feature: air below left free deck end
tests.note: Free-end underside remains open; no invented block fills its overhang.

thin_warning: Fine guard ropes, sagging-net strands, grazing slices at curved cables and slender rim ends can fall below the 0.8 mm erosion core. Global connected-section erosion can hide attached details, hence isolated aperture and rail-bay checks. No failure is exempted. Crop boundaries may create thin end slices; those remain recorded and are explicitly not global normal-wall measurements.
limitations: 29 column axes are verified as model occupancy, not surveyed source positions. Numerical crop/ray samples are not exhaustive wall thickness, loading, cable strength, extrusion-width, bridge, FFF, accessibility or physical-print simulation. Broad roof underside, thin ropes, raised deck ends and T counter require slicer support/orientation review. Downward area is not an automatic support or filament estimate.
